technique.summary: Manipulate the OAuth redirect_uri parameter to steal authorization codes or tokens by redirecting them to an attacker-controlled endpoint. Exploits weak redirect_uri validation in the authorization server.
steps: Identify the OAuth authorization endpoint and its redirect_uri parameter
Test if redirect_uri validation is strict, prefix-based, or regex-based
Chain with open redirect on the legitimate domain if one exists
Craft a malicious authorization URL and capture the leaked auth code/token

payloads.notes: Subdomain confusion — evil.com controls the subdomain

bypassTechniques: Use URL encoding/double encoding of path separators
Abuse open redirect on the legitimate domain as a redirect_uri chain
Register a subdomain under the legitimate app's domain if possible
Use response_mode=fragment to leak tokens via Referer header
